publication.title: A Basal Sauropodomorph (Dinosauria: Saurischia) from the Ischigualasto Formation (Triassic, Carnian) and the Early Evolution of Sauropodomorpha

locality.name: Valle Pintado, Hollada de Ischigualasto, Ischigualasto Provincial Park

age.basis: Holotypic layer 40 m above the formation base and approximately level with a dated ash.
age.notes: The paper reports ca. 228.3 Ma and a Lower Carnian age; numerical uncertainty is not specified in the specimen description.

claims.summary: PVSJ 874 is designated the holotype of Panphagia protos.
The holotype preserves partial cranial, axial, pectoral, pelvic, hindlimb and pedal elements.
The holotype occurs 40 m above the base of the Ischigualasto Formation, approximately at the level of the dated ash used for the reported age.
